notes: Opened 1929 as a girls' boarding school, then a guest ranch; a Historic Hotels of America member. 97 rooms, casitas and suites in Spanish Colonial adobe, over 14,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor function space across six meeting rooms, the 2,910 sq ft Casa Luna and the 3,400 sq ft Casa Alcalde residence. The resort markets itself for full buyouts.
